inlines.v: CUSHION, noun 1. A pillow for a seat; a soft pad to be placed on a chair; a bag, stuffed with wool, hair or other soft material. 2. A bag of leather filled with sand, used by engravers to support the plate. 3. In gilding, a stuffing of fine tow or wool, covered by leather, on a board; used for receiving the leaves of gold from the paper, in order to its being cut into proper sizes and figures. Ladys cushion a plant, a species of saxifraga. Sea cushion sea pink or thrift, a species of Statice. CUSHION, verb transitive To seat on a cushion
